title: no-op cargo build adds latency to binary relaunch on macOS
author: ishermandom
body_preview: ### Problem  On macOS, `cargo build` appears to always rewrite the binary file on disk, even when the contents have not changed.  This has a performance cost: macOS detects the new file as unverified, and runs a malware scan on first launch.
